- [LLET.10.3] **Inlined, not memoised.** A pure `let`
  binding that references a series aggregation
  (`let z = (t.state - t.mean) / t.stdev` where
  `t.mean` / `t.stdev` are companion slots)
  re-evaluates every time the engine
  re-evaluates any use site. Same cost as
  writing the expression inline. Authors who
  want memoisation promote to `emit` facts or
  use the cache plane.
